summary: National Registry certified Paramedic with 10 years of continuous prehospital experience in high-volume 911 and inter-facility transport settings. Proven ability to deliver advanced life support, manage critical scenes, and mentor newer EMS personnel in growing mid-market organizations.

experience.title: Paramedic
experience.employer: a growing mid-market regional EMS provider
bullets: Provide advanced life support on a 911 response unit averaging 12 calls per 12-hour shift, including cardiac arrests, traumas, and respiratory emergencies.
Perform patient assessments, 12-lead ECG acquisition and interpretation, IV/IO access, medication administration, and airway management under medical direction.
Document patient care electronically with 98% billing-compliant chart completion and participate in continuous quality improvement case reviews.
Precept newly hired EMTs and paramedic students, coaching scene safety, documentation standards, and clinical decision-making.
Maintain fleet readiness by checking controlled medications, defibrillators, and oxygen equipment at the start of every shift.

experience.title: Paramedic
experience.employer: a mid-sized municipal fire and rescue department
bullets: Delivered ALS care as part of a two-person ambulance crew across a service area of approximately 60,000 residents.
Triaged and treated patients at multi-casualty incidents, coordinating with fire, law enforcement, and receiving hospital staff.
Operated and maintained cardiac monitors, ventilators, infusion pumps, and spinal immobilization equipment.
Served on the department safety committee, contributing to a 20% reduction in reported lifting injuries over two years.
Completed monthly training in pediatric emergencies, hazardous materials response, and mass casualty operations.

experience.title: EMT-Intermediate
experience.employer: a growing mid-market private ambulance company
bullets: Responded to emergent and non-emergent calls, performing patient assessment, vital sign monitoring, and basic airway support.
Administered oxygen, assisted with prescribed medications, and supported paramedic partners during advanced procedures.
Transported patients between hospitals, skilled nursing facilities, and residences while maintaining comfort and dignity.
Verified insurance and billing documentation, reducing claim rejections through accurate run report submission.
Restocked and sanitized the ambulance after each transport to meet infection-control and readiness standards.

experience.title: EMT-Basic
bullets: Provided basic life support, hemorrhage control, splinting, and safe patient movement on emergency and transfer calls.
Conducted scene size-up and communicated patient condition to receiving facilities and oncoming crews.
Inspected and maintained medical supplies and vehicles, logging equipment checks each shift.
Completed continuing education hours in CPR, first aid, and emergency vehicle operations.

education.degree: Associate of Applied Science in Emergency Medical Services
